text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Family
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On New Year's Day of the Classic Year—to 
my surprise, I was invited by 
Gentildonna's father to attend a gathering 
at her family home."
choice_data_list:
(I'm nervous... but I have to put on a 
brave face!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. Thank you for taking the 
trouble to come. I've been wanting to 
speak with you at least once.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
Together with the Trainer my daughter 
chose. ............

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: "Hmm. So that's Gentildonna's..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, start by reporting last 
year's results. ...Do not disappoint me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
“—In summary, last year's project 
achievement rate was 100%... concluding a 
flawless year.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one speaking right now is her younger 
brother, the only boy among the 
siblings... Judging by his looks, he seems 
to be in middle school.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, this year we will further 
strengthen each department and expand our 
field.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
With everyone's support, my enterprise is 
already beginning to make a global impact.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
"...The one who should succeed the family 
head is the strongest. I understand that 
definition to mean one who unites power 
and achieves even greater results."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
Not someone who acts utterly tyrannical, 
only looking out for their own benefit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those words were directed unmistakably at 
Gentildonna. Her family's gazes pierced 
into her... but she—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Now then. I suppose it's my turn next?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You all certainly had quite a lot to say 
when reporting your own achievements, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I only have one thing to say.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I will bring you the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Please enjoy the view from your current 
seats, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, and also... I shall arrange a 
separate seat for Father as well."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: For that is where my throne shall be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sharp chill made the atmosphere even 
more searing. Gentildonna simply stared 
straight into her father's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
"Gentil...! How dare you be so rude to 
Father...!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
Victory in a race? Why would that be the 
ultimate proof of—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
Very well, Gentildonna... I shall remember 
those words.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
I, too, have pursued my own interests to 
amass this much wealth. Thus, I understand 
full well the tremendous power it holds.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
With what kind of power will you bring us 
to our knees? ...I shall look forward to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well then, everyone— may you all have a 
wonderful year.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...She's the one Gentil chose. I'm sure 
she made no mistake, but..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text: Someone. Go after those two.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Make preparations on the side as well. 
The strong always keep their options open—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The tense round of greetings finally 
ended... Leaving the mansion, I was 
finally able to catch my breath.
choice_data_list:
Your family has quite an impressive 
presence when they're all together.

Your family is quite impressive when 
you're all together, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I can't speak for anyone else, but knowing 
Father, it makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That commanding aura worn only by those 
who have achieved greatness. That 
dignified presence... belongs exclusively 
to Father.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The determination to pursue strength is 
something I acquired by following my 
father's example.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—I look forward to the day you surpass me. 
Though I've already bested you in 
strength... Ohoho.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: —Gentil. Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
I am Gentile's older sister. Thank you for 
looking after my little sister.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Sister. Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
A message from Father. He asked me to 
introduce part of our business to you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you have time after this, right?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please choose whichever catches 
your interest from this list.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna's older sister handed me a 
list of facilities owned by their family. 
The one that caught my eye was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart is drawn to that ultra 
high-intensity lineup. I might be able to 
learn the secret behind the overwhelming 
aura Gentildonna's family gave off...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's go see how things are 
going.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Arriving at the gym, one is astounded by 
the extensive array of top-tier workout 
equipment available as a matter of course, 
not to mention the prestigious lineup of 
clientele.
choice_data_list:
Ah! That person won the world 
championship...!

text_block_list.name: Trainee
text_block_list.text: Hmphhh... Uuuuaaaagh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If it were me, I could lift that person 
right up along with it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Why are you panicking? There's no way 
she's being serious.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It's not a heavy load, nor does it hold 
any meaning.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, please take a look at this 
machine— it's the only one of its kind in 
the world. I shall continue the tour."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While being guided through the facility... 
I suddenly wonder. Why did Gentildonna's 
father suggest giving me a tour of these 
facilities in the first place—?
choice_data_list:
(...My resolve is being tested, I 
suppose.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's branded as 'super recovery', after 
all. I might find a hint for when 
Gentildonna gets exhausted down the line.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho. Quite a splendid facility.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"You might be a little surprised by this, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I was guided to the "spa"... or so 
I thought—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Just the reaction I expected.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Of course, they are all fakes. Flawless 
fakes, crafted to be as indistinguishable 
from the real thing as possible, though.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Light, wind, sound... Every single detail 
is refined. The pinnacle of technology, 
brought together by wealth and 
connections, is gathered right here.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A reality forged by power... Isn't it 
beautiful?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
We also have rooms like the "Golden 
Chamber," crafted entirely from genuine 
gold. Let us continue the tour.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While being guided through the facility... 
I suddenly wonder. Why did Gentildonna's 
father suggest giving me a tour of these 
facilities in the first place—?
choice_data_list:
(...My resolve is being tested, I 
suppose.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The amusement park immediately caught my 
eye. The word 'Danger' is concerning, 
though... Perhaps it's just meant to add 
some spice.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho. You have quite a bit of nerve, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, shall I introduce you to 
the most dangerous attraction first?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Arriving at the amusement park, the ride 
we were led to was... a dizzyingly tall 
free-fall tower...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
As of right now, it boasts the title of 
the world's tallest.
choice_data_list: Num... ber one... in the world...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured. We haven't had a single 
accident since our grand opening.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
We perform safety and endurance tests 
regularly, ensuring everything is 
thoroughly inspected.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It seems to be very popular with people 
whose daily lives lack thrill.
choice_data_list: So Gentil went through this too...?
Did you go through it too, Gentil...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I learned quite a bit on the mental 
side. Would you like to join me?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. I hope you won't come to regret 
this?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... You've gone completely pale.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
...Once we've rested, let's move on. There 
are plenty of other unique attractions 
here that you won't find anywhere else in 
the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While being guided through the facility... 
I suddenly wonder. Why did Gentildonna's 
father suggest giving me a tour of these 
facilities in the first place—?
choice_data_list:
(...My resolve is being tested, I 
suppose.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everything I saw today speaks volumes 
about how incredible her family is. 
Wondering if I can measure up to that 
standard... I felt like I was being tested 
at every turn.
choice_data_list:
(In that case... let's live up to those 
expectations.)

(In that case... let's live up to those 
expectations.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
“—That is all. If you'll excuse me, I will 
take my leave.”

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Gentil. We are always... watching your 
conduct."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: ...No, what I just said was for my sister.
choice_data_list:
As your Trainer, I'll accept it together 
with you

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, right, I forgot to mention something.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you again 
this year, Trainer.
